Last season I put one 50-kilogram bag of DAP and half a bag of urea on each hectare of barley, and the yield was good enough to cover my costs. Since this 2.29-hectare plot is rented, I need to make sure I produce enough to pay the landlord, so I will use the same fertilizer again even though cash is tight. I will sow my own barley seed that I kept from last year, because buying new seed is too expensive when I already know this grain grows well on this soil. At harvest time I will hire workers for about twenty days total, because 2.29 hectares is too much for my family to cut and thresh alone.
